blocks.tamil_translation: guard your tongue; if you do so, you will gain mastery over Shaytan,” Hazrat Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) narrates.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ سَعِيْدِ نِ الْخُدْرِيِّ ﵁ رَفَعَهُ قَالَ: اِذَا اَصْبَحَ ابْنُ آدَمَ فَاِنَّ اْلاَعْضَاءَ كُلَّهَا تُكَفِّرُ اللِّسَانَ فَتَقُوْلُ: اِتِّقِ اللهَ فِيْنَا فَاِنَّمَا نَحْنُ بِكَ، فَاِنِ اسْتَقَمْتَ اِسْتَقَمْنَا، وَاِنِ اعْوَجَجْتَ اِعْوَجَجْنَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي، باب ما جاء في حفظ اللسان، رقم:٢٤٠٧
blocks.tamil_translation: “When the son of Adam reaches the morning, all the organs of his body very humbly plead with the tongue, “Fear Allah Ta'ala in our matter, for our affairs are (bound up) with you. If you stay straight, we will stay straight; if you become crooked, we too will become crooked” (and then we will have to suffer the punishment for it),” Hazrat Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: سُئِلَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ عَنْ اَكْثَرِ مَا يُدْخِلُ النَّاسَ الْجَنَّةَ،قَالَ: تَقْوَي اللهِ وَحُسْنُ الْخُلُقِ ، وَسُئِلَ عَنْ اَكْثَرِ مَا يُدْخِلُ النَّاسَ النَّارَ، قَالَ: الْفَمُ وَالْفَرْجُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث صحيح غريب، باب ما جاء في حسن الخلق، رقم:٢٠٠٤
blocks.tamil_translation: “When the Prophet ﷺ was asked what are the things that most cause people to enter Jannah, he said, “Taqwa (fearing Allah Ta'ala) and good character.”” When the Prophet ﷺ was asked what deed most causes people to enter Jahannam, “Misusing the tongue and the private parts,” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.
